name: Kindly Wellness
subtitle: AI Mental Wellness Companion
shortDescription: Free with ads. Remove ads anytime with the one-time Remove Ads purchase.
longDescription:
Kindly is your AI-powered mental wellness companion, designed for both individuals seeking daily mental health support and healthcare professionals who need
  clinical tools for patient care.

Built with evidence-based techniques from CBT, DBT, and ACT — Kindly helps you track your mood, journal your thoughts, practice breathing exercises, and build
  healthier habits. All from one private, offline app.

FREE WELLNESS TOOLS (9 features, free forever):
  • Mood Tracking — Log your daily mood with emoji-based tracking
  • AI Chat — Conversational wellness companion using CBT/DBT/ACT techniques
  • Journal — Guided journaling with AI prompts
  • Breathing Exercises — Animated breathing guides for calm and focus
  • Affirmations — Daily positive affirmations
  • Coping Toolkit — Evidence-based coping strategies
  • Gratitude Journal — Daily gratitude practice
  • Daily Check-In — Quick daily wellness assessment
  • Crisis Safety — Immediate access to 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline and emergency resources

PRO TOOLS ($4.99/month or $39.99/year):
  • Mood Insights & Analytics — Visualize mood patterns over time
  • Sleep Log — Track sleep duration and quality
  • Habit Tracker — Build and track daily habits
  • Worry Journal — Reframe anxious thoughts
  • Emotion Wheel — Explore and identify complex emotions
  • Weekly Reflection — Structured weekly self-review
  • Self-Care Planner — Plan and track self-care activities
  • Mindfulness Timer — Guided mindfulness sessions
  • Data Export — Export your data in JSON/CSV
  • Safety Plan — Personalized crisis safety plan

CLINICAL TOOLS ($19.99/month or $149.99/year):
  • Everything in Pro included
  • Patient Dashboard — Manage patient caseloads
  • Clinical Notes — SOAP-format session documentation
  • Outcome Tracking — PHQ-9, GAD-7, PCL-5, AUDIT assessments
  • Session Management — Schedule and track sessions
  • Client Mood Overview — Monitor patient mood trends
  • Treatment Plans — Create and track treatment goals
  • Progress Reports — Generate clinical reports
  • Institutional Analytics — Aggregate outcome data

### Important Disclaimer:
Kindly is a wellness companion, not a substitute for professional mental health care. It does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease or mental health
  condition. If you are experiencing a crisis, please call 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline).
whatsNew: Ads now appear in the free parts of the app. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns them off (Restore Purchases is in Settings). Bug fixes and improvements.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
